questions.group_pattern: a rectangular timber beam is # cm wide and # cm deep. what is its second moment of area about the bending axis? (i = bd# ÷ #)

kept.question: A rectangular timber beam is 10 cm wide and 30 cm deep. What is its second moment of area about the bending axis? (I = bd³ ÷ 12)
A rectangular timber beam is 30 cm wide and 90 cm deep. What is its second moment of area about the bending axis? (I = bd³ ÷ 12)

questions.question: A rectangular timber beam is 20 cm wide and 40 cm deep. What is its second moment of area about the bending axis? (I = bd³ ÷ 12)
questions.explanation: I = 20 x 40³ ÷ 12 = 20 x 64,000 ÷ 12 = 106,667 cm⁴. Depth is cubed, so deep beams are far stiffer.
original_row: A rectangular timber beam is 20 cm wide and 40 cm deep. What is its second moment of area about the bending axis? (I = bd³ ÷ 12)
I = 20 x 40³ ÷ 12 = 20 x 64,000 ÷ 12 = 106,667 cm⁴. Depth is cubed, so deep beams are far stiffer.
একটা আয়তাকার কাঠের কড়ি 20 cm চওড়া আর 40 cm গভীর। বাঁকার অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে দ্বিতীয় ক্ষেত্র-ভ্রামক কত? (I = bd³ ÷ 12)
I = 20 x 40³ ÷ 12 = 20 x 64,000 ÷ 12 = 106,667 cm⁴। গভীরতার ঘন হয়, তাই গভীর কড়ি অনেক বেশি দৃঢ়।

original_row: A firm holds inventory for 90 days, collects from customers in 60 days and pays suppliers in 75 days. What is its cash conversion cycle?

অ-নিয়ন্ত্রক স্বার্থ = 25% x 150 = 37.5: সহায়ককে 100% একত্রিত করা হয়, বাইরের অংশ আলাদা দেখানো হয়।
